quotes.text: the issue of AI is one that, you know, we have to get right. There is no debate about that. Winning on AI and harnessing it for good requires, as you all have said very, I think, impactfully, clear instructions and guidance and meaningful investments.

The WISeR pilot picked six States — Ohio included — to test whether or not the following is a idea: To use AI to deny healthcare to seniors. [...] The first time they are going to use AI is to deny healthcare to seniors. [...] And that is why this is being called by many, many people these AI death panels because AI is going to make decisions on whether or not somebody gets the healthcare they need, and that decision may lead to that person losing their life. [...] My bill prohibits HHS from doing WISeR, from testing WISeR, using AI to deny care in Medicare. [...] There is no transparency or little transparency. [...] And then the lines of code that will be deciding whether or not somebody gets healthcare — which is insane — there is no transparency for that either.
